scheme_name: CG Startup Policy & Nava Raipur Innovation City
overview: The CG Startup Policy & Nava Raipur Innovation City is a state-level initiative by the Government of Chhattisgarh aimed at fostering a vibrant startup ecosystem through financial support, infrastructure development, and policy incentives. It focuses on promoting innovation, entrepreneurship, and job creation within the state by providing startups with access to funding, incubation facilities, and regulatory ease. The policy is anchored around the development of Nava Raipur as an innovation hub to attract and nurture early-stage ventures.
objectives: Promote innovation and entrepreneurship across Chhattisgarh
Develop Nava Raipur as a dedicated innovation city for startups
Provide financial and infrastructural support to early-stage ventures
Create employment opportunities through startup-led growth
Establish a conducive regulatory environment for new businesses
Encourage sector-specific innovation in areas like agri-tech, health-tech, and manufacturing
eligibility: Startups incorporated in Chhattisgarh or willing to relocate to the state, with a focus on innovative, scalable business models. Preference is given to entities registered under the Companies Act, 2013, or as LLPs/partnership firms. Startups must be working on technology-driven or socially impactful solutions and should not have exceeded a specified turnover or age limit as defined under the policy.
benefits: Eligible startups receive access to seed funding, incubation support at Nava Raipur Innovation City, mentorship, networking opportunities, and assistance in regulatory compliance. Additional benefits include access to shared infrastructure, prototype development facilities, and linkages with investors and industry experts. The policy also facilitates participation in national and international startup events and provides support for intellectual property rights (IPR) filing.
financial_support: Financial support is provided through seed grants, equity-based funding, and soft loans, with disbursement managed via a designated state-level startup fund. The quantum of support varies based on the stage of the startup and the nature of the project, with early-stage ventures eligible for grants up to a certain limit. Funds are released in tranches upon achievement of predefined milestones, and disbursement is monitored by the implementing agency.
application_process: 1. Visit the official CG Startup Policy portal at https://cgstartup.in 2. Register as a startup on the portal by providing basic entity and promoter details 3. Fill in the online application form with details about the business model, innovation, and funding requirement 5. Upload required documents such as incorporation certificate, PAN, pitch deck, and bank details 6. Submit the application for review by the screening committee 7. Await evaluation and possible interview or pitch presentation 8. Receive approval and disbursement of funds or allocation of incubation space upon selection
required_documents: Proof of innovation or prototype (if applicable)
implementing_agency: Department of Commerce and Industries, Government of Chhattisgarh
caveats: Benefits are subject to availability of funds and approval by the state-level screening committee
Startups must maintain a minimum operational presence in Chhattisgarh to continue availing benefits
Misrepresentation of facts or failure to meet milestones may lead to withdrawal of support
Equity-based funding may involve dilution as per agreed terms
